conviction_note: Event is real (board on 12 Nov per the issuer's 2026 calendar and Radiocor's agenda) and the release should land mid-session inside the bmo window. Nothing unpriced turned up: the tough Q3 trade comp (+7.5% sell-out in Q3 2025), the slowing book market and the education pull-forward into Q2 are all public or company-flagged, and the guide is expected to be reiterated at the upper end. So the findings are small (sum -0.2), p_up sits just under 50 (47), and abs_move_pct is 3.0. That is the reiterated-guide base, kept above this low-vol name's own sub-2% history because hunters here have under-sized moves.

already_public.what: FY2026 guidance: low single-digit revenue and adj. EBITDA growth, margin ~17%, ordinary cash flow EUR 65-70m. Reiterated with H1 'nella parte alta delle stime' (upper end), helped by Hoepli Education
Original FY2026 guidance and dividend policy (8% yield)
Company projects the Italian book market at about +2% for FY2026, against GfK +5.1% at June and +4.3% to July, so a slower H2 is implied by the company itself
Italian trade book market for 9M 2026 (NielsenIQ via AIE): EUR 1,026.5m, +3.2% in value, against +3.8% for Jan-Apr. Group houses hold 5 of the 9M top 10 (Mondadori 3, Einaudi 2)
School textbooks (AIE): 2026 list prices +2.3% / +1.8%, average family spend -1.4%

new_in_release.expect: Q3 numbers are not pre-released. Revenue is likely up year on year on scope (Hoepli Education's main season, Edilportale, MA Retail). Organic trade is likely flat to soft against Q3 2025's +7.5% sell-out. Q3 adj. EBITDA is roughly flat to slightly up on a Q3 2025 base of about EUR 88.1m (9M25 128.6 less H1 2025 40.5).

Expected to be reiterated at the upper end of low single-digit. A formal raise is possible but not indicated, because management framed Hoepli as reaching the 'parte alta' inside the range. Not confirming the upper end would be the downside case.
Unknown. Net debt was up at June (EUR -262.1m pre-IFRS 16) on M&A and dividends. Q3 is seasonally working-capital-heavy for education.
October trade sell-out commentary is likely. Unknown sign. Last year the release said October continued the Q3 trend.
No change expected. The second tranche of EUR 0.077 goes ex on 23 Nov, outside the window.

findings.finding: Q3 trade books faces a hard comp: Q3 2025 group sell-out was +7.5% in a market up about 4%. The 2026 market is slowing (GfK +5.1% at June, +4.3% to July; NielsenIQ 9M +3.2% against +3.8% Jan-Apr), so Q3 organic trade is likely flat to soft.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Trade drives about 35% of group EBITDA. On 13 Nov 2025 the release flagged the +7.5% Q3 sell-out and the stock closed +0.71% on the day and -1.89% the next (Yahoo bars). On 12 Feb 2026 the December market miss behind the FY25 revenue shortfall came with -2.12%.
findings.original_quote: le case editrici del Gruppo Mondadori hanno registrato nel terzo trimestre una significativa crescita (+7,5%) [the Group's publishing houses posted significant growth in the third quarter (+7.5%)]; 2026: 'in crescita a giugno del 5,1% (+4,3% fino a luglio)' [up 5.1% at June (+4.3% to July)]; 'La proiezione di Mondadori è che il mercato chiuda il 2026 su del 2%' [Mondadori projects the market to close 2026 up 2%]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The comp, the market series and the company's own +2% full-year market projection are public. If the market were surprised by a soft Q3 trade print, the stock would not be near its 60-day level. The only unpriced part is the exact Q3 sell-out number, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: NielsenIQ/AIE 9M series via Libreriamo (https://libreriamo.it/libri/libri-piu-venduti-italia-primi-9-mesi-2026/) and the CEO's GfK figures in ItaliaOggi (https://www.italiaoggi.it/marketing-e-media/marketing/mondadori-nel-semestre-ricavi-per-415-9-milioni-e-attese-sugli-audiolibri-jvts6tgm). Different panels, same direction.

findings.finding: H1 education revenue was flattered by deliveries pulled forward into Q2 ('anticipazione dei rifornimenti ai clienti direzionali'), a timing headwind for organic Q3 education. It is offset by Hoepli Education (2.5 points of the 34.7% adoption share), consolidated from May.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same Q2 pull-forward in 2025 was previewed as Education -6% YoY in Q3 2025 (Websim preview, Oct 2025). That 9M print closed +0.71% on the day.
findings.original_quote: I ricavi consolidati hanno inoltre beneficiato della variazione positiva ascrivibile all'anticipazione dei rifornimenti ai clienti direzionali. [Consolidated revenue also benefited from the positive change attributable to earlier restocking of directional customers.]
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The company disclosed it and covering brokers model the seasonal phasing. It is filed because the Q3 organic education number is new in the release and could read as weak to a headline reader.
findings.independence: Websim's 3Q25 preview flagged the identical mechanism a year earlier (https://www.websim.it/azioni/small-mid-cap/notizie/mondadori-preview-risultati-3q25-forte-ripresa-della-divisione-trade-trend-9m-in-linea-con-l-outlook-sull-anno-20251014051513/).

findings.finding: Management has already said FY2026 will land in the upper part of its low single-digit guide, helped by Hoepli. A reiteration at the upper end is the expected outcome and lands inside what the company guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Reiterations moved little: 13 May 2026 -0.49% on the day, 13 Nov 2025 +0.71%, 30 Jul 2026 -0.24% the next day. A guidance shortfall (12 Feb 2026, FY25 revenue below the low single-digit guide) came with -2.12%.
findings.original_quote: ci consente di confermare le nostre previsioni per l'intero esercizio 2026, con il raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi nella parte alta delle stime [allows us to confirm our forecasts for the whole of 2026, reaching our targets in the upper part of the range]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The upper-end statement is public and Intesa Sanpaolo's Buy and EUR 2.60 target were reiterated after H1. A formal raise would be unpriced, but nothing sourced points to one, hence the near-zero size.
findings.independence: Websim, 1 Aug 2026: 'Mondadori - 1H solido e Hoepli sostengono la parte alta della guidance' (https://www.websim.it/azioni/analisi-fondamentale-italia/mondadori-1h-solido-e-hoepli-sostengono-la-parte-alta-della-guidance/)

baseline_tension: Agrees with a flat baseline: no short position, a flat 20d run-up and a +2.8% 5d drift, and the evidence is mildly negative on the quarter and neutral on the guide, so there is nothing to beat.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': shrank the trade-comp finding from -0.3 to -0.2 and the education pull-forward from -0.2 to -0.1, because the comp, the market series and the timing effect are all company-disclosed or public

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and the 2.3% median for reiterated guides: raised abs_move_pct from 2.5 to 3.0 despite this name's sub-2% history. The history moves p_up, not abs_move
The session lesson: session_check opens with the verdict and cites the timestamps of prior mid-session releases
positioning: the truncated zero is reported as no anchor (anchor_covered false), not as nobody short
